description: PhoneWagon provides call tracking software to help businesses improve their marketing spend by associating unique local phone numbers with each marketing campaign, enabling them to quickly test new ads and turn off campaigns that are not working. Businesses can also automatically send text messages based on events like missed calls to keep prospects engaged.

Presence Learning is the leading provider of live online speech therapy, online occupational therapy, and online behavior and mental health services. With the ongoing shortage of speech language pathologists, occupational therapists, and mental health service providers reaching crisis proportions, innovative modes of delivery have become essential for providing special needs people with access to the therapeutic services.

Senic replaces ‘graphical user interfaces’ by turning objects and surfaces into ‘natural user interfaces.’ Its first product Nuimo is an elegant gesture and touch activated controller for audio and video systems and high-precision graphical software – it is among the top-funded projects on both Kickstarter and Indiegogo. Senic is a Y Combinator alumnus.

SIEMonster is an affordable Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) software solution. SEIMonster’s products provide protection against cyberthreats and security monitoring at an affordable price point with the scalability and features of more expensive solutions.

Sleeper is a platform to engage sports fans through sports messenger apps, social games, and interactive content. Its monetization strategy is through premium content, virtual currency, gated access, and skins/stickers/emojis.

SPIDR Tech is the world’s first community engagement platform for law enforcement. The company’s platform leverages technology to help police departments spend less money and time on case management and follow-up. This simultaneously increases community engagement and results in safer communities and more efficient government agencies. The company is a TechStars NYC alum.

TallyGo provides a state-of-the-art real-time navigation software development kit that can be integrated into existing apps with virtually no development effort. It provides a new method of GPS routing that detects how traffic is behaving in real-time prior to the beginning of a route.

TenMarks provides personalized online math practice and enrichment programs for first through twelfth graders using a structured approach of practice, on-demand hints, video lessons, and real-time results. It lets teachers specify math skill levels or concepts to cover and then develop personalized curriculums it calls playlists. It was acquired by Amazon.

The Zebra aims to be a Kayak for auto insurance, enabling users to shop anonymously for insurance, comparing multiple quotes in real-time. Leveraging an innovative comparison platform, the company has delivered over 5m quotes across 200 insurance companies.

Treatspace develops secure social software designed to manage the referral process for healthcare providers, medical practices, and hospitals. The company’s Health Networks align physician referrals, power online patient engagement, and facilitate clinical collaboration. Its SaaS-based applications work with any EMR system and are adaptable to the needs of each client.

Umano is an audio publishing and distribution platform that allows users to listen to articles on mobile devices. The company offers a news broadcast (not a robotic, text-to-speech translator) with a variety of personalized playlists for listeners around specific topics or themes, all read by professional voice actors. It was acquired by Dropbox.

Walkthrough is a transaction-based virtual reality platform that enables anyone to take high-end marketing photos for real estate properties with just a smartphone. The software aims to turn the lens on a smartphone into a professional camera and enables the picture taker to dramatically improve the quality of marketing photos.
YayPay is a SaaS workflow management tool for accounts receivable, enabling enterprises to speed up collections and improve working capital turnover.
